124: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.

A trip back in time from the present to...

Birth and death are extraordinary experiences. Life is a fleeting pleasure.

Lawrence 'Larry' Stewart Talbot / The Wolf Man

Queen Doris of the Sixth Dimension

Growing Up Can Be Painfully Funny.

Climbing the corporate ladder can be murder.

Fake it until you break it.

The Incredible True Story of Formula One's Greatest Family.

25 years. One unsolved mystery. And countless unanswered questions.

Winners are just losers who win.

It takes balls to be a woman.

It pays to be the big guy.

Head of the family Arend wants to be happy. Mother Jeannette wants somebody to want her. Written by Topkapi Films

The Cry Was Revenge - And One Man Vowed to Stop the Bloodshed of Two Warring Nations!

Timely! Tremendous! Thrilling! Drama of Love and a Jail-Break!

33404: The story evolves around the Arian sect. During the III century AD they have seriously shaken the very foundations of Christian world. 33916: When three siblings agree to meet and discuss their aging father's future, their reunion spirals into bickering, bantering and reliving old grudges.

Parton / Alexandre / Francis / Julian / Hokuro / Doctor / Assistant / Mummies / Boss / Subordinate / Other (voice)

38268: One of the most ambitious Bulgarian projects in recent years, Heights is an adaptation of Milen Ruskov's novel of the same name, published in 2011. THE WEIRDEST! THE WILDEST! Half Woman! Half Stone!
38780: A group of musicians travel to London after finding renewed success with a new singer. They end up winning the lottery, but misplace the winning ticket.
39036: A likeable, married high school teacher spirals out of control when a student in his class begins unintentionally reminding him of his doomed first love, which ended 17 years earlier.
A mysterious memory of feeling love...

A hoodlum look-alike assumes the identity of a noble man.

Saleem Ahmad 'Cut-Piece Saleem Suiting Shirting' aka Meduim Mia

She rules a palace of pleasure

Life is a stage. Find your voice. Change the world.

The screen's first great rock 'n' roll feature!

But all does not go smoothly when Antonio is forced to go on a hunting trip.

A secret agent who does not work for peanuts!

Gab / Gabriela  Benedictos De La Cuesta
Dos / José Ibarra García González Jr.
